name: Hailun de Shen Ji
source:
Bereaved by the war, the heroine had been into sleep in the ruins of gods for three hundred years. After awakening, she lost her memory in order to save the life of the man who had awakened her from the miracle. But the new life seems not so smooth as expected...
Do you want to live a warm and busy life with your new friends, or to pursue the truth that made you lose everything three hundred years ago？
There are variety of characters: loyal guardian, mystery magician, faded gentility, enemy seemed has met before...
As the heroine, you will meet a bunch of people, and some of them are warm, others are cold. Each of them had an untold story. Go to unlock the secrets and tear them down.
If these handsome men cannot satisfy your desire, then you can also choose to be the queen of vengeance. In a word, the fate of the heroine is in your hand...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2264050/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
因战乱而失去亲人的女主角，在诸神废墟中沉睡了三百年。觉醒后，为了拯救将她从奇迹中唤醒的男人的生命，她失去了记忆。但新的生活似乎并没有想象中那么顺利……
你想和新朋友一起过着温馨忙碌的生活，还是去追寻三百年前让你失去一切的真相？
角色多种多样：忠诚的守护者、神秘的魔法师、褪去的温柔、似曾相识的敌人……
作为女主角，你会遇到一群人，有的人热情，有的人冷酷。他们每个人都有一个不为人知的故事。去解开秘密并把它们拆掉。
如果这些帅哥不能满足你的欲望，那么你也可以选择成为复仇女王。总而言之，女主角的命运掌握在你的手中……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2264050/]Steam[/url]]
